direction.label: Warm Companion
direction.hypothesis: Softer proportions and attentive gesture increase approachability without turning Lyra into a cute or overly human robot

asset.surface: Starlight Research Team character direction review

prompt.primary_request: Evolve Lyra toward an attentive and approachable research companion while preserving competence, machine identity, and the current Starlight world
prompt.scene: A quiet dark research room with tactile paper evidence and a warm human work light outside the robot's body
prompt.subject: Lyra, the same porcelain-and-obsidian non-human research conductor, listening before routing the next task
prompt.style_medium: high-fidelity cinematic editorial character render with humane restraint
prompt.composition: full-body four-to-five portrait, eye-level, stable grounded stance, open hands at working height, clean readable outline
prompt.lighting_mood: soft warm key light balanced by very restrained cyan optics, attentive and trustworthy rather than theatrical
prompt.color_palette: warm aged porcelain, obsidian, ink blue, muted brass, soft cyan, human-owned amber light
prompt.materials_textures: matte porcelain with subtle wear, quiet black mechanics, soft functional textile, tactile paper and metal evidence objects
constraints: preserve Lyra's segmented porcelain cranium and narrow black faceplate
preserve clearly non-human construction and adult human scale
use softer shoulder arcs and lower optical intensity
show listening and bounded handoff through posture rather than facial mimicry
keep the warm authority light associated with the human workspace
avoid: human skin or human facial mimicry
prompt.final_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: 4:5 Starlight character direction preview. Image 1 is the owned Lyra edit target and identity reference. Preserve Lyra's segmented ivory porcelain cranium, narrow black faceplate, clearly non-human construction, adult human scale, obsidian mechanics, ink-blue accents, and calm competence. Evolve the character toward Warm Companion without making it cute or human: softer shoulder arcs, slightly more grounded proportions, low-intensity cyan optical apertures, open attentive hands at working height, and a listening posture before the next bounded handoff. Place Lyra in a quiet dark research room with tactile paper evidence and one warm human-owned work light outside the robot body. Show a small physical task packet between the hands, not floating UI. Matte aged porcelain with subtle wear, quiet black mechanics, soft functional textile, muted brushed brass. No text, no logos, no human skin, no human facial mimicry, no mascot proportions, no pedestal, no weapons, no combat armor, no crown, divine core, superhero stance, or glowing-heart trope.

qa.strongest_element: The quiet optics, open hands, tactile packet, and warm external lamp create the most approachable and trustworthy Lyra
qa.weakest_element: The crop and archive-room cues read more as a careful librarian than a conductor coordinating several research lanes
qa.next_change: Carry the listening posture and material warmth into a full-body relay composition with multiple bounded inputs and one routed output
